body:
H8 REVIEW FINDING, 2026-09-04, from the T263 PR 8a scan-scale lens. Three read paths in src/gateway/container.ts cost more than they need to, and two of them grew hotter when a bound connection's default read widened from one container to its whole subtree.

(1) containerScopeImpl's inbox lookup is `requested x containers`. src/gateway/container.ts:876. For every requested container it walks the WHOLE container table looking for records whose inboxOf matches. connectionScopeImpl now passes `subtreeUnder(table, bound)` as `requested` by default, so a bound read costs O(subtree x all containers). One pass building a Map from inboxOf to inbox names answers identically at O(C).

(2) One full-store term evaluation per gathered container, and per EXCLUDED container anywhere in the store. src/gateway/container.ts:860, driven from :888 and :897. membersOf calls gw.select, which evaluates the term over the entire store and caches nothing. The `minus` loop iterates `table.excluded` whole rather than the exclusions inside the requested set, and an exclusion outside the requested set can only subtract ids that were never gathered.

(3) subtreeUnder is a fixpoint where one pass would do. src/gateway/container.ts:1091. It re-walks every container once per level of depth. The fixpoint exists only because the table's iteration order does not guarantee parents precede children; a Map from parent to children plus a BFS removes the ordering dependency at O(C).

NONE OF THESE IS NEW LAW. They are existing reads, and the change that made two of them hotter has landed. This is a repair, not a decision.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) The inbox lookup is not quadratic: a store with many containers and a wide requested set does the same work as a store with a narrow one, per container. Verify: a case in test/gateway/ that builds N containers and asserts the gather visits each container record a bounded number of times.
(b) The exclusion loop considers only exclusions inside the requested set, and the served View is unchanged for a case where an exclusion sits outside it. Verify: same file, two-sided.
(c) subtreeUnder returns exactly what it returns today for a deep chain, a wide fan, a cycle, and a self-parent. Verify: a case that pins all four shapes against the current output.
(d) No read path in this file materializes the whole store where a target lookup answers. Verify: the diff, plus the existing container rails staying green.

Merge tier: a performance repair with no change to what any door serves. The model self-merges on green.
title: Three container reads cost more than the answer needs
